integrity: Complete proof with exact order-statistic identities, direct independent allocation checker, and exact rational spacing computations; computational enumeration is supplemental to the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Two centers with exactly two agents each, identical strictly positive additive valuations, exactly four or five goods; independent continuous uniform and exponential sampling for probability matrices. Not an arbitrary heterogeneous-valuation or large-market claim.
title: Exact four-to-five-good feasibility transitions for two-center delegated fairness
